title: Thinness trade-offs in laptop battery life
why: Thinner designs cut battery capacity, and engineers target battery life equal to the last generation, so efficiency gains get cancelled out.

title: Argument about a leaked document's harm

title: Inside bsnes: decapping chips for accurate SNES emulation
why: Accuracy-first emulation preserves games that depend on bugs; decapping cartridge coprocessors extracted firmware, enabling 100% compatibility.

title: Why owning music beats streaming playlists
why: Opinion that scarcity and commitment make purchased music more valued than streamed playlists.

title: GNU rejected LLVM merger in 2005

title: Pushback on Torvalds' ARM server take

title: Why equity crowdfunding hurts small investors

title: Air-FI: noise-based covert channel from air-gapped PCs
why: The Air-FI channel encodes data as noise in Wi-Fi bands, readable by Wi-Fi chipsets at ~10 bits/s, but needs malware already on the target.

title: Satirical alcoholic self-description

title: Getting from SFO to Mountain View by transit

title: Parody of an internal memo post

title: Midwest versus coastal city living

title: Degrees as a hiring filter

title: Defense of libertarianism versus externalities

title: Signal versus noise in growing forums

title: Changed view of NSA after Snowden

title: Why exposing a NAS to the internet is risky

title: Personal account of addiction and work

title: Why mmap alone is unsafe for databases
why: mmap alone is unsafe for a database: it needs write-ahead logging and control over when data persists, or the OS flushes garbage.
